thoughts.title: New thoughts
thoughts.description: New ideas are coming to me.
thoughts.description1: When I first came to Purdue University, I never imagined that I would become a Teaching Assistant for one of my favorite classes. This journey led me to co-found the Association of Black Computer Scientists (ABCS), creating a space for Black students within the Computer Science department.

content.paragraph1: Little did I know, when I touched my first laptop, that I would become passionate about computer science and project development. My journey began with creating Minecraft servers, developing addons, and designing websites and shops for these servers. After successfully running several servers with more than 10,000 players, I decided to go deeper into computer science.
content.paragraph2: Today, I have built several private, public, and class projects, some of which have generated income. Currently, I am focused on creating side projects to showcase my skills, particularly using C++, a language I am eager to learn more about and thoroughly enjoy programming in.
content.paragraph3: When I am not coding, I enjoy playing any type of sports or games, working out, watching series, reading, and spending time with friends and family.
content.paragraph4: Feel free to reach out; I love meeting new people and engaging in conversations. I hope you liked visiting my portfolio.
